
::: {#def-equivalence .theorem}
## Equivalence

Two [random variables](#def-random-variable) are equivalent if they belong to different [observational units](#def-observational-unit) but represent the same construct. 

$$
X_i\sim X_j\iff \ X_i\in  \mathscr{O}_i;\ X_j\in  \mathscr{O}_j,\ X_i \text{ same construct } X_j \ (i\ne j).
$$
 
 


:::
